The Dutch '''[[Eredivisie]] in the 1957–58 season''' was contested by 18 teams. At the end of the competition, [[FC Utrecht|Door Oefening Sterk]] (DOS) and [[Sportclub Enschede|SC Enschede]] shared the lead with 47 points. According to the rules, an extra match was required. It was played at a neutral field ([[De Goffert]], [[Nijmegen]]) and [[FC Utrecht|Door Oefening Sterk]] won the championship by winning 1-0 [[after extra time]].<ref>{{Cite web|url=http://www.eredivisie.nl/subpage.aspx?l1=1667&l2=1668|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20071008130800/http://www.eredivisie.nl/subpage.aspx?l1=1667&l2=1668|url-status=dead|title=De officiële website van Eredivisie - Historie|archive-date=October 8, 2007|website=Eredivisie.nl|access-date=July 26, 2026}}</ref>

Another play-off was held to determine which team had to relegate. [[USV Elinkwijk|Elinkwijk]] played [[FC Groningen|GVAV]] at neutral terrain and won 2–1. Therefore, GVAV relegated.

==Championship play-off==

{{OneLegStart}}
{{OneLegResult|'''[[FC Utrecht|DOS]]'''|| 1–0 {{aet}} |[[Sportclub Enschede|SC Enschede]]||}}
{{end}}
[[FC Utrecht|DOS]] won the championship, and qualified for [[1958–59 European Cup]].

==Relegation play-off==

{{OneLegStart}}
{{OneLegResult|'''[[USV Elinkwijk|Elinkwijk]]'''|| 2–1 |[[FC Groningen|GVAV]]||}}
{{end}}
[[FC Groningen|GVAV]] were relegated to [[1958–59 Eerste Divisie|Eerste Divisie]].
